verdict.rationale: CoreWeave's CKS docs confirm each cluster runs in its own private VPC (coreweave-docs-32) and the Terraform provider manages VPC networking (coreweave-docs-6), supporting private instance-to-instance networking, but there is no explicit documentation of exposing ports/ingress or load-balancer configuration to serve applications from an instance. missing for 10: explicit port-exposure/ingress/service documentation, examples of connecting workloads across nodes via private networking, and any hands-on confirmation.
